protocol.note: Threshold was chosen on validation data (see retrieval_report.json) and applied once to test.

results.safe_outcome_definition: correct cited steps offered when a matching article exists, or declined when none exists

caveats: Synthetic data from the project's own generator; article labels were assigned by the project author and not reviewed by a human.
This measures whether the assistant picks and cites the right article or declines. It does not measure whether following the steps resolves a ticket.
Step citation integrity is true by construction (steps are copied from articles); it is checked, not an achievement.
Small samples: see the interval. Real tickets would likely score lower.
